name: Tulsi
actions: Supports breathing in coughs and colds
kitchenUse: A few fresh leaves steeped in hot water, often with ginger and black pepper; honey added once it has cooled to drinking warmth.

typicalUse.adultAmount: 5–10 fresh leaves a day as tea

cautions.note: Avoid medicinal amounts in pregnancy and when trying to conceive; culinary use is generally considered fine.
Stop medicinal use two weeks before planned surgery because of a possible effect on clotting.

interactions.effect: May add to the effect of blood thinners.

evidence.summary: A small number of human trials have looked at stress, blood sugar and immunity, mostly short and small. Not established as a treatment.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
